The override commits to tip_lane with operator attribution and is visible in tip_quorum's reorg notifications.

quota_aggregator pre-aggregates incoming usage deltas in-memory by (tenant, plan_version, tenant_cluster, HLC bucket) before proposing to aggregate_lane, so consensus throughput on aggregate_lane scales with bucket count rather than raw delta arrival rate.

When the pre-aggregation buffer exceeds a documented watermark, quota_aggregator sheds by ceiling-proximity class: aggregates well under the per-plan ceiling are dropped first with a loss-attestation; aggregates near or crossing a ceiling retain admission priority into aggregate_lane so throttle-flag tombstones are not delayed by low-severity delta floods.

Inter-region channel cert rotation runs with an overlap window: lifecycle_gate admits a cert rotation only when remaining validity on the active cert exceeds a documented overlap budget. During the overlap, both old and new cert are trusted on the inter-region channel so consensus on the rotation itself rides the old cert while the new cert is distributed via control_lane; trust handover to the new cert is atomic at the HLC effective-from stamp recorded with the rotation entry.

If the overlap window is breached (no successful rotation committed before the active cert nears expiry), lifecycle_gate raises an emergency-cert-recovery event in control_lane and stops admitting any non-cert-rotation lifecycle events. Recovery from total cert expiry is delegated to a parent-scope out-of-band bootstrap surface — region_coordinator alone cannot recover consensus over a channel whose only authenticator has expired.

Documented operational pauses (VM live migration and any successor pause classes) are first-class lifecycle events scheduled and admitted by lifecycle_gate via CAS into control_lane, with a recorded pause-window and the affected region(s).

hlc_service consults control_lane for pause-in-progress entries; while a pause-in-progress entry covers its region, sample-vs-median delta is evaluated against a wider pause-mode bound and the region does not auto-trip skew-degraded mode for delta excursions explainable by the pause. On pause-end, hlc_service re-syncs from multi-peer median and only then resumes normal max-allowed-delta enforcement.

quorum_core validates the HLC stamp on every lane entry at commit time: missing stamps and stamps beyond max-allowed-delta are rejected. Lane consumers can rely on stamps as monotonic within tolerance for cross-lane happens-before reconstruction.

While the leader's hlc_service is in skew-degraded mode, quorum_core suspends admission of entry kinds that participate in security-critical cross-lane happens-before reconstruction (revocation-then-attestation, erasure-tombstone-then-offboarding-attestation, fast-path flag-applied attestations); other admissions carry an HLC-degraded annotation visible to consumers.

tip_quorum's N independent observations for (chain, fork_id) admission must come from N distinct regions, not merely N distinct chain_router replicas; multiple replicas in the same region count once for the threshold so colluding replicas within a region cannot satisfy the threshold alone.

tip_quorum's source-quarantine rules include set-level cross-source correlation: a (chain, fork_id) candidate witnessed only by sources in suspicious correlation (synchronized timing, identical observation deltas, no other regional witness) is held probationary even when no single source violates per-source rate; the correlated set is surfaced in alerts.

offboarding_orchestrator tracks per-downstream-component best-effort-attestation rate. Crossing a documented breaker threshold opens a component-outage state: new offboarding signals for that component are suspended, a component-outage alert is raised, and erasure tombstones that would touch the component's data class are held in a queued-pending-component-recovery state in tombstone_lane rather than rapidly accumulating best-effort attestations.

tombstone_lane recognizes a queued-pending-component-recovery entry kind for erasure tombstones whose downstream component is in an open component-outage breaker state; the queue drains via normal offboarding flow once the breaker closes; the queue is itself audited and alerted if depth exceeds a documented bound.

lifecycle_gate's operator-override admission path needs an operator-credential authorization model with M-of-N signing requirements, credential-rotation, compromise-revocation, and per-operator audit so a single compromised credential cannot issue override admissions; tip_quorum implements local M-of-N gating but parent scope must define and enforce the operator credential model.

residency_publisher implements 2PC PREPARE/COMMIT/ABORT: PREPARE binds prepared-V+1 to per-tenant quarantine-and-relocate-complete-ack from tenant_store; without ack residency_publisher cannot proceed. COMMIT activates V+1 via M-of-regions quorum-witnessed CAS, re-validating prepared-ack and per-region ack-quorum. ABORT is HLC-window-bounded and idempotent on (tenant_key, V+1, attempt_id); same abort_id twice is a no-op; strictly newer attempt_id starts fresh from V's current state. PREPARED-ORPHAN degraded mode on prepared-window expiry without commit.

residency_publisher provides a pre-warm hydration channel rate-limited per-region: on consumer cold-start the consumer requests pre-warm delivering currently-active V's full state synchronously, ack-readies inline as part of registration, only then begins serving residency-pinned traffic. Bounded queue depth, queue-overflow returns pre-warm-deferred, consumer falls to deny-by-default. Honors monotonic-per-(consumer, instance_id, version).

credential_roster rotation is 2PC at zoom: rotation-prepare commits prepared-V+1 entry to control_lane and broadcasts to override-admission consumers; rotation-activate is M-of-regions quorum-witnessed; consumers consult active roster_version on every commit; in-flight override proposals at activate-HLC are cancel-by-roster-version atomically with the activation broadcast. Compromise-revocation carries retroactive-as-of-HLC; broadcasts whose emit-HLC >= retroactive-as-of-HLC become invalid and lifecycle_gate re-signs and re-broadcasts within bounded-batching.

lifecycle_gate-signed broadcasts (drain-fence in particular) carry the signing roster_version as part of the broadcast itself; consumers verify signatures against the broadcast's NAMED roster_version, not a cached version. Signed broadcasts remain verifiable for the duration of their HLC-bounded ack window even after a scheduled roster rotation activates a strictly newer version.

lifecycle_gate originates drain-fence broadcasts on observing erasure-tombstone for tenant T; broadcast carries fence-HLC f_T and signing roster_version; every named writer flushes in-flight audit writes for T to compliance_audit then acks drain to tenant_store within the HLC-bounded ack window; offboarding_orchestrator tracks per-(T, writer) ack state via durable phase markers.

lifecycle_gate admits bulk-offboarding waves with documented max-tenants-per-wave and inter-wave spacing; per-writer bounded ack queues with explicit back-pressure stall further wave admission rather than dropping broadcasts or expiring HLC windows; per-tenant HLC-bounded ack windows start from per-tenant ack-broadcast-emit-HLC, not from the bulk operator action HLC.

lifecycle_gate's teardown-overlap interlock: node-teardown is not admitted while any in-flight per-tenant drain-fence on that node is unacked. Nodes that cannot flush within their teardown window write a durable drain-ack-handoff record naming a successor instance or persistent buffer; ack-by-handoff is treated as ack for the certificate of deletion. No silent drop and no unbounded wait.

lease_issuer issues per-tenant single-writer lease tokens with HLC-bounded TTL via M-of-regions quorum-witnessed activation pattern (lease-prepared then lease-activated); supports renewal under same lease_id with extended TTL; supports revocation; emergency lease re-bootstrap when all lease_issuer regions are simultaneously unavailable is rooted in cert_bootstrap's OOB anchor under elevated M-of-N narrowly scoped to lease re-bootstrap. Issuer-plane availability target documented separately from inter-region channel.

lease_issuer requires HLC-stamped handoff-fence ack from tenant_store before issuing lease_v_new: writes handoff-fence to lease_lane, calls tenant_store's handoff-fence acknowledgement endpoint, awaits ack confirming fence is observable to all subsequent writes for the tenant key, then commits lease-activated for lease_v_new. Without ack, lease_v_new MUST NOT be issued. Ack is audited via compliance_audit_owner.

Audit-key destruction is two-phase clock-skew-bounded fence: (PHASE A) drain-fence broadcast carries fence-HLC f_T; every writer must ack drain-of-in-flight-audit-writes-for-T at writer-local HLC >= f_T + skew_bound where skew_bound is hlc_service's degraded-mode bound. (PHASE B) lifecycle_gate's audit-key DESTROYED event for T is issued at HLC t_destroy >= max(observed_ack_hlc, f_T + skew_bound) + write-delivery-grace; compliance_audit_owner publishes write-delivery-grace and installs late-write-rejection cutoff at compliance_audit on DESTROYED commit. Late writes after the cutoff are rejected at admission and surfaced to a protocol-violation log.

gateway_health_surface publishes per-(region, Subrole) liveness samples carrying monotonic freshness signal (freshness_seq, sampled_hlc); freshness window is bounded by hlc_service skew_bound + inter-region propagation budget with wider window under skew-degraded; routing-affecting classifications require cross-witness from at least two regions agreeing within the documented cross-witness window; single-region classifications held probationary; stale-surface fallback at edge: residency-pinned operations deny-by-default, residency-neutral operations continue under last-observed liveness.

cert_bootstrap's OOB trust anchor is M-of-N hardware-rooted material across geographically and organizationally distinct custodians with anchor-rotation procedure committed via quorum_core, anchor-availability-test cadence committed via control_lane; emergency cert recovery, roster-bootstrap, anchor rotation, and emergency lease re-bootstrap require human authorization under M-of-N with elevated threshold for cert re-rooting and roster-bootstrap; every operation writes a typed entry to compliance_audit via compliance_audit_owner.

credential_roster is the single owner of operator-credential roster publication and consumer-ack tracking; lifecycle_gate, tip_quorum, residency_publisher, lease_issuer, flag_propagator, offboarding_orchestrator, compliance_audit_owner, cert_bootstrap consume the active roster_version via control_lane (committed by credential_roster through quorum_core) and CAS-reject any override commit whose effective roster_version is below active roster_version. credential_roster's cold-start / post-full-revocation re-bootstrap is rooted in cert_bootstrap's OOB anchor.

offboarding_orchestrator maintains per-(offboarding_id, component_id) durable phase markers (RECEIVED, FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS, FLUSH-COMPLETE, ACK-EMITTED, ATTESTATION-WRITTEN, TERMINAL) in control_lane; never retracts a drain-ack already emitted for that key; observed_ack_hlc for the slowest writer is consumed by lifecycle_gate's PHASE B audit-key destruction t_destroy computation.

lifecycle_gate's PHASE B audit-key destruction CAS proposal includes a lease-quiescent precondition for tenant T (no active or prepared lease for T, no in-flight handoff-fence for T). lease_issuer publishes the per-tenant lease-quiescent flag to control_lane. On erasure-tombstone for T, lease_issuer force-revokes any active lease for T as part of the drain-fence broadcast pipeline and refuses further handoff-fence requests for T. The flag flips only after force-revocation commits and any in-flight handoff is completed or aborted.

compliance_audit_owner's late-write cutoff is tenant-key-scoped: any writer with active or prepared lease for T at any HLC up to t_destroy is bounded; late writes from any writer for T after DESTROYED are rejected at admission regardless of writer_id and surfaced to the protocol-violation log.

lifecycle_gate maintains a per-tenant residency-2PC-in-flight lock in control_lane: PREPARE commit acquires; COMMIT/ABORT/PREPARED-ORPHAN release; competing PREPARE for same tenant T is CAS-rejected with reason 'residency-2PC-already-in-flight'. The lock is HLC-bounded (matches prepared-window). PREPARED-ORPHAN is a terminal state per (tenant_key, V+1) tuple — fresh attempt_id cannot escape PREPARED-ORPHAN; recovery requires operator M-of-N elevated AND tenant_store clean-rollback-complete.

residency_publisher pins active roster_version at PREPARE; COMMIT and ABORT proposals carry the pinned roster_version, not the current one. lifecycle_gate sequences roster rotation-activate only after in-flight residency 2PCs reach terminal state under the prior roster, OR the rotation-activate carries a residency-2PC-cancel-and-abort directive (elevated M-of-N) that issues idempotent abort-V+1 entries for every in-flight 2PC before the activation commits.

residency_publisher operates pre-warm hydration in two modes: (a) steady-state per-region RPS cap for routine churn; (b) region-failover burst-mode activated on observing a quorum-witnessed region-failover event in control_lane, replacing the RPS cap with a per-region burst-budget sized to absorb worst-case correlated-cold-start with HLC-bounded burst window matching the failover RTO. Burst-mode uses bulk-snapshot delivery via a region-local cache endpoint that is itself residency_publisher-controlled, cert-bearing, and monotonic-per-(consumer, instance_id, version); instances pull from the local cache and ack-ready inline. Burst-mode entry and exit events are written to control_lane.

drain-ack-handoff records are first-class durable obligations with their own SLA-tracked lifecycle: pending-flush state with HLC-bounded flush deadline at commit; named successor writes handoff-accepted entry referencing record-id; on flush completion successor commits handoff-flushed entry containing flushed-write attestation; on deadline expiry without handoff-flushed, lifecycle_gate raises handoff-overdue alarm and certificate-of-deletion exception register entry escalates from handoff-pending to handoff-overdue-investigation-required.

compliance_audit_owner installs the tenant-key-scoped late-write cutoff for T only after every handoff record for T has reached handoff-flushed terminal state OR has been explicitly resolved-with-loss-attestation under operator M-of-N. PHASE B audit-key DESTROYED commits before handoff resolution only when every handoff record for T carries a no-residual-writes-expected flag (writer's flush-then-ack-then-teardown completed without unflushed writes; the handoff is a no-op audit record).

Decommissioning a successor buffer is a lifecycle event admitted by lifecycle_gate that requires all pending-flush handoff records the buffer owns to be either resolved or transferred-to-another-successor (recursive handoff re-applying the same SLA contract); a buffer cannot be decommissioned while any unresolved handoff is still owned by it.

gateway_health_surface publishes single-region routing-affecting classifications to health_lane with the single observing region named and an explicit cross-witness-pending annotation; edge applies a partial-trust routing policy: safety-direction transitions (more conservative, e.g. fanout-suspended) are applied immediately under partial-trust with a 'partial-trust-routing-active' header on outgoing requests; permissive-direction transitions (less conservative) require full cross-witness before applying. Cross-witness window expiry without second witness escalates to operator-attention rather than silent rejection.

lifecycle_gate may issue an operator-override classification (under M-of-N from credential_roster's published roster) that promotes a single-region classification past the cross-witness window with operator attribution recorded into health_lane and audited via compliance_audit_owner.

cert_bootstrap maintains continuous per-anchor-element liveness state in control_lane via custodian-published heartbeat-attestations on a documented sub-test-cadence interval; missing heartbeat for documented intervals marks the anchor element anchor-unhealthy and raises an alarm. M-of-N counts only anchor-healthy elements; anchor-healthy count below M raises anchor-quorum-degraded proactively before any emergency. anchor-availability-tests remain as defense-in-depth against heartbeat falsification.

Anchor rotation (replacing a failed anchor element) is admitted by lifecycle_gate as a first-class lifecycle event subject to bounded-batching; replacement anchors join under the still-reachable elevated M-of-N applied against anchor-healthy count. Emergency recovery thresholds (elevated-tier-A for cert re-rooting/roster-bootstrap, elevated-tier-B for emergency lease re-bootstrap) reference M-of-N against anchor-healthy count, never against total anchor count, so degradation is monotonic.

lifecycle_gate's bulk-offboarding wave admission CAS proposal includes lease_issuer's CAS budget headroom and every named-writer's bounded queue depth as preconditions; admission is rejected with 'lease-issuer-budget-insufficient' or 'writer-queue-full' when the precondition fails; bulk-admission backs off with exponential-with-jitter. lease_issuer publishes its current CAS budget headroom to control_lane.

lease_issuer reserves a dedicated lease-revoke-during-erasure CAS sub-budget within its per-proposer budget that is not consumable by routine lease ops; published separately to control_lane so bulk-admission precondition checks against the dedicated sub-budget headroom — routine lease churn does not starve erasure-driven force-revocations.

drain-acks carry the writer's hlc_service status (healthy / skew-degraded / pause-mode) at ack-emission time as a typed annotation, signed by the writer's hlc_service over the cert-bearing inter-region channel. offboarding_orchestrator rejects drain-acks emitted under skew-degraded; writer must re-ack after returning to healthy state. Pause-mode writers emit drain-ack-pause-deferred records carrying pause-window HLC bounds; ack-by-handoff with pause-window-end as deferred-completion HLC.

lifecycle_gate's PHASE B t_destroy computation uses observed_ack_hlc only when every contributing drain-ack was emitted under healthy hlc_service; otherwise t_destroy is computed from the worst-case drain-ack-pause-deferred completion HLC + skew_bound + write-delivery-grace. PHASE B does not commit until any pause-window has ended and a healthy-mode drain-ack has landed for affected writers.

Re-sign-and-rebroadcast does not reset per-tenant ack windows for tenants whose broadcast had already reached an ack-completed phase (FLUSH-COMPLETE, ACK-EMITTED, ATTESTATION-WRITTEN, TERMINAL); lifecycle_gate's re-emission carries a per-tenant signature-only-update annotation updating the broadcast's signing roster_version in offboarding_orchestrator's phase marker without resetting the window. Only tenants not yet ack-completed receive a fresh ack window.

Re-emission has its own dedicated bandwidth budget within lifecycle_gate's broadcast pipeline, separate from new-wave admission, sized as a fraction of total broadcast pipeline capacity to bound impact on new-wave admission.

credential_roster's compromise-revocation broadcast carries an explicit per-tenant reaffirmation-or-reissue decision tree based on phase marker state: ack-completed -> reaffirmation entry (signature update only); not-yet-ack-completed -> reissue with fresh ack window. compliance_audit_owner records the per-tenant decision in the typed audit log; certificate-of-deletion vouches for the signature transition unambiguously.

residency_publisher's prepared-window is per-(tenant_key, V+1) and dynamically sized: tenant_store reports estimated_quarantine_duration in a preliminary PREPARE-estimate exchange; residency_publisher computes prepared-window = max(min-window, estimated_duration * documented_safety_margin) capped at absolute-max-window; estimate bounded by per-tenant quotas in control_lane. residency_publisher may extend the prepared-window once before absolute-max-window if observable progress reports from tenant_store land; extension is committed as prepared-window-extended entry to control_lane and operator-visible. PREPARED-ORPHAN is the safety net for genuine stalls beyond absolute-max-window.

offboarding_orchestrator's certificate-of-deletion MUST include a structured deletion_status enum (CLEAN | PARTIAL_HANDOFF_LOSS | RESIDENCY_ABORTED | AUDIT_KEY_PHASE_A_PENDING | COMPOUND) with terminal-fact roll-up over per-component phase markers, residency 2PC outcome, audit-key destruction phase, and handoff-record SLA terminal state per (offboarding_id, tenant_id, component_id).

offboarding_orchestrator MUST refuse to issue a certificate-of-deletion while any handoff-record SLA for the (offboarding_id, tenant_id) is non-terminal, unless an explicit operator-attested resolved-with-loss-attestation override (signed under elevated-tier-A) is recorded in control_lane and referenced in the certificate.

compliance_audit_owner MUST reject any certificate-of-deletion lacking the required deletion_status roll-up or referencing an unrecorded resolved-with-loss-attestation; rejected certificates are recorded as audit-rejection entries in control_lane and trigger paging on-call.

lifecycle_gate broadcast pipeline MUST shed-and-defer non-critical PHASE A audit-key destruction entries when in-flight residency 2PC PREPAREs exceed a configured watermark; deferred entries are written as explicit deferral records in control_lane with cause and HLC, and re-emitted when the watermark clears, with no silent stall.

lease_lane MUST provide two priority sub-streams within its reserved consensus throughput: a lease-revoke-priority sub-stream carrying lease-revoked, lease-revoke-during-erasure, and force-revoke entries, and a lease-prepared sub-stream carrying M-of-regions ack-collection. A lease-revoke for tenant T MUST commit ahead of any lease-prepared for T regardless of arrival order; cross-tenant entries preserve FIFO within sub-stream.

lease_issuer MUST emit a prepared-orphan record when a force-revoke or lease-revoke-during-erasure supersedes an in-flight lease-prepared for the same tenant; prepared-orphan entries MUST be bounded-reaped with a per-tenant cap to prevent unbounded backlog.

lease-prepared entries MUST carry an admission-deadline-HLC; expired prepared entries MUST transition to prepared-expired, be reaped from lane head, and emit a prepared-expired audit entry referencing the originating M-of-regions ack window.

lifecycle_gate bulk-wave admission MUST budget bulk-offboarding throughput against lease-revoke-priority sub-stream capacity (not total lease_lane capacity); back-pressure on bulk-wave is signaled when the revoke sub-stream nears its budget independent of lease-prepared occupancy.

gateway_health_surface MUST stamp every partial-trust safety-direction transition for a region R with a lease_lane-cross-witnessed-up-to HLC; the transition MUST NOT be published until lease_lane has been observed up to that HLC at the publisher and the value is recorded in the health_lane entry.

Consumers of health_lane partial-trust transitions (e.g., edge) MUST refuse to apply the partial-trust header for region R until they have also observed lease_lane up to the lease_lane-cross-witnessed-up-to HLC carried in the transition.

lease_issuer MUST stamp lease-revoke (and lease-revoke-during-erasure) entries with the originating-region-set of the lease so health_lane and consumers can determine which leases are within scope of a region-down partial-trust transition.

quorum_core's HLC-degraded interlock MUST classify the following entries as security-critical: lease_lane {lease-prepared, lease-revoke, lease-revoke-during-erasure, force-revoke, prepared-orphan, prepared-expired}; health_lane {partial-trust-transition, classification-pending, classification-witness-timeout, anchor-quorum-degraded}. Under HLC-degraded mode these are suspended with explicit deferral records.

Under HLC-degraded mode, lease-revoke (and lease-revoke-during-erasure) entries retain their lease-revoke-priority semantics but MUST be HLC-stamp-revalidated against hlc_service immediately before commit; revalidation failure transitions the entry to revoke-pending-hlc-recovery and emits a deferral record.

health_lane partial-trust transitions emitted under HLC-degraded mode MUST be downgraded to safety-direction-only (no permissive direction) and MUST carry an hlc-degraded-source flag; consumers MUST treat the cross-witness stamp as provisional and MUST NOT relax safety guards on its basis.

lease_issuer MUST introduce a prepared-revoked state for lease-prepared entries bound to a compromised roster_version on receipt of compromise-revocation broadcast; such entries MUST transition atomically and MUST NOT commit even if late M-of-regions acks arrive. prepared-revoked entries are recorded in lease_lane and reaped on a bounded schedule.

lease_lane MUST provide a third priority sub-stream lease-reissue (distinct from lease-revoke-priority and lease-prepared) with its own bounded budget; lease-reissue entries MUST be HLC-ordered after the compromise-revocation broadcast HLC and MUST NOT commit before any lease-revoke for the same tenant.

lifecycle_gate MUST surface an explicit back-pressure signal (recorded in control_lane and paged on-call) when the lease-reissue sub-stream budget saturates beyond a configurable horizon following a compromise-revocation broadcast; the signal carries the elapsed reissue lag and the count of pending reissues.

gateway_health_surface MUST tag every classification-pending and partial-trust-transition entry written to health_lane with originating-cause-class (operator-bulk-wave, regional-network, internal-degradation, unknown), sourced from lifecycle_gate's bulk-wave context when applicable.

Entries tagged operator-bulk-wave MUST be subject to a separate, longer classification-witness-timeout SLO; per-entry pages MUST be suppressed and replaced by a single bulk-wave-health-summary published once per wave by gateway_health_surface; only deviations from the wave's expected health envelope page on-call.

lifecycle_gate MUST publish bulk-wave start and end markers on control_lane carrying (offboarding_id, wave_id, expected-region-set, expected-degradation-envelope); health_lane consumers MUST correlate classification entries with these markers via wave_id.

lifecycle_gate's rotation-activate MUST record an activation HLC; records signed strictly before the activation HLC verify under V_old and records signed strictly after verify under V_new. credential_roster MUST retain V_old as verifiable for at least max(residency-2PC-in-flight-lock max-window, handoff-record SLA max-window) past activation.

residency_publisher's roster-pin at PREPARE MUST include the rotation-activation-HLC observed at PREPARE; if a rotation-activate would land before the in-flight COMMIT, the 2PC MUST either complete before the activation HLC or transition to residency-2PC-cancel-and-abort under elevated-tier-A directive.

compliance_audit_owner MUST accept chain-of-custody records signed under V_old as long as the activation HLC and V_old verification key are within the bounded retention window declared by credential_roster; records outside the window MUST be flagged audit-key-expired-cannot-verify and routed to manual review.
drain-ack-handoff records MUST embed the roster_version under which they were signed AND the rotation-activation-HLC observed at signing time, so cross-version verification is unambiguous on replay.

gateway_health_surface MUST detect cross-witness deadlock between simultaneous partial-trust transitions; on detection, the affected regions MUST be classified as a region-set-failover and a single coordinated transition issued whose lease_lane-cross-witnessed-up-to HLC is computed against quorum_core's quorum-observed lease_lane HLC, not either region's local witness.

lease_issuer MUST emit lease-revoke entries for tenants whose leases name any region in a region-set-failover under quorum_core's commit witness, not under either failing region's local witness, breaking cross-region deadlock cycles.

health_lane MUST carry an explicit region-set-failover entry kind with the union region-set, the coordinated cross-witness HLC, and the originating-cause-class; consumers MUST apply a single barrier per region-set-failover rather than per-region barriers in such cases.

satisfactions.explanation: quorum_core is the consensus engine deployed across regions; canonical state is committed only on quorum acknowledgement and applied to the per-class lanes (tombstone_lane, tip_lane, aggregate_lane, control_lane). Failure of any single region or replica does not cause loss of canonical state or progress as long as a quorum survives; minority-region partition handling (degraded reads + bounded buffers + heal-time replay) preserves the property under transient partition.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition gates cert and origin-endpoint rotations region-staggered (at most one region transitions a given surface in a maintenance window); the schedule is a CAS proposal committed via quorum_core into control_lane so the staggering is canonical, not deployment discipline.
lifecycle_gate gates origin-endpoint rotations under the same region-staggered cadence as cert rotation; rotation events are CAS-committed via quorum_core into control_lane.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition gates pool rotations to one pool / one region / one wave at a time, admitted via CAS proposals through quorum_core; the precondition payload includes the latest tip-quorum size set so the canonical-tip quorum size is held above its safe threshold throughout — atomically, not via a TOCTOU check.

lifecycle_gate writes rotation-in-progress and drain-in-progress tags via CAS through quorum_core into control_lane; chain_router (parent) reads those tags from control_lane to suppress quarantines triggered solely by the documented rotation window.

tip_quorum partitions head observations by (chain, fork) and computes a single canonical tip per pair via quorum across regional chain pools; canonical-tip records are CAS-committed via quorum_core into tip_lane.

tip_quorum reads tip-stale set from tip_lane and excludes any tip-stale pool's vote from quorum computation; the exclusion is canonical because the tip-stale set is itself a quorum-committed lane entry.
tip_quorum CAS-commits rollback notifications keyed on globally-meaningful chain coordinates via quorum_core into tip_lane; every region's fanout reads the same coherent rollback through the lane.

offboarding_orchestrator reads erasure tombstones from tombstone_lane and signals downstream parent components in the documented order with idempotency keys; collected attestations are CAS-committed via quorum_core into control_lane and the aggregate certificate (incl. complete-with-exceptions) is forwarded to metrics_store's compliance audit trail.

quota_aggregator receives sub-second per-(tenant, plan_version, tenant_cluster) deltas, maintains rolling aggregates committed via quorum_core into aggregate_lane, and proposes throttle-flag tombstones into tombstone_lane when ceilings are crossed; HLC bucketing comes from hlc_service.

flag_propagator watches tombstone_lane and writes flags to every region's auth_cache via the unified fast-path with documented per-region SLO; high-severity flags use deny-during-propagation pending markers and per-region flag-applied attestations land in control_lane via quorum_core.

residency_publisher commits versioned residency policies via quorum_core into control_lane (with effective-from HLC stamps and two-phase activation for tightening) and pushes new versions to consumers; consumers pin and propagate the version they enforced.

hlc_service exchanges HLC samples out-of-band over the cert-bearing inter-region channel (consensus needs HLC, so the dependency is not inverted); samples beyond max-allowed-delta are discarded; local HLC is computed from a multi-peer median (N >= 3); a region failing to agree within window is forced into the parent-defined skew-degraded mode.
quorum_core's redefinition: 'on network partition, minority-region quorum_core replicas serve reads from locally-applied lane state with a partition-stale freshness annotation'.
quorum_core's redefinition: 'minority-region quorum_core replicas reject proposals fast with a retryable-on-quorum-region signal'.

quorum_core's redefinition: 'bounded-watermark input buffers absorb non-discardable inputs (overflow: drop-with-loss-attestation for low-severity, alert-escalation for high-severity)'; the policy is also in quota_aggregator and tip_quorum redefinitions for their input streams.

quorum_core's redefinition: 'on heal, buffered work is replayed via quorum_core with idempotency keys so duplicates land but only commit once'; subservice redefinitions echo the idempotency-key replay behavior.

Each lane node's definition declares its compaction policy: tombstone_lane retains full history through snapshots; tip_lane retains latest+bounded-reorg-window; aggregate_lane folds into per-period summaries; control_lane retains rotation events post-completion and attestations until forwarded.
quorum_core's redefinition: 'snapshot+truncate at watermark intervals; replicas catch up via snapshot transfer plus log-tail rather than full-log replay'.
tombstone_lane's definition: 'tombstone history is retained in full through snapshots so revocation semantics survive compaction'.

Four lane nodes (tombstone_lane, tip_lane, aggregate_lane, control_lane) are explicit Log-typed nodes; quorum_core's definition states 'reserved consensus throughput per lane and head-of-line blocking is contained within a lane'.
tombstone_lane's definition: 'documented end-to-end commit-latency SLO (the unified fast-path SLO), monitored independently of bulk throughput'.
Each lane's definition states entries 'carry HLC stamps'; quorum_core's CAS proposals attach HLC, so consumers reconstruct happens-before across lanes via HLC.
tip_quorum's redefinition: 'per-source rate limits drop excess submissions and flag the source'.

tip_quorum's redefinition: '(chain, fork_id) candidate admission requires N independent regional observations across a documented window before the fork_id is committed to tip_lane; below threshold the candidate is held in a probationary set'.
tip_quorum's redefinition: 'quarantines sources that violate per-source rate or cross-source-correlation rules; quarantines surface as alerts and exclude the quarantined source from quorum'.
hlc_service's redefinition: 'samples beyond max-allowed-delta are discarded and the source flagged but does not advance the local clock'.
hlc_service's redefinition: 'local HLC is computed from a multi-peer median (N >= 3 peer samples)'.

hlc_service's redefinition: 'a region failing to agree with multi-peer median within max-allowed-delta for a documented window is automatically forced into the parent-defined skew-degraded mode and stops accepting writes that depend on time-bucketed enforcement'.

offboarding_orchestrator's redefinition: 'each component has a documented attestation SLO; on timeout, offboarding_orchestrator records a best-effort attestation with evidence and escalation owner instead of waiting indefinitely'.

offboarding_orchestrator's redefinition: 'aggregate certificate of deletion is issued in complete-with-exceptions state when every component has either a timely attestation or a recorded best-effort attestation; exceptions tracked in a separate exception register on control_lane with their own SLA'.

offboarding_orchestrator's redefinition: 'where a preservation hold covers a data class, the affected component returns a preservation-blocked attestation with the hold reference — a recognized terminal state'.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition: 'CAS proposals attach the latest read of (per-(chain, fork) quorum-size set, rotation-in-progress set, tip-stale set, schema-capability config, drain-in-progress set) as the precondition; commit re-validates atomically'. quorum_core's redefinition supports CAS commit semantics.
lifecycle_gate's redefinition: 'commit re-validates atomically; if rejected, lifecycle_gate re-reads latest applied state and re-proposes with refreshed preconditions'.
residency_publisher's redefinition: 'each tenant's residency policy carries explicit version + effective-from HLC stamp; consumers pin and propagate the version they enforced'.

residency_publisher's redefinition: 'tightening changes use a two-phase apply: phase 1 commits the new version with effective-from in the future (push-and-acknowledge window), phase 2 activates the version; activation is globally-ordered via HLC'.
residency_publisher's redefinition: 'consumers that fail to acknowledge readiness within the push-and-acknowledge window default to deny-by-default for the affected tenant'.
Each lane definition states entries 'carry HLC stamps and schema_version tags'; quorum_core's redefinition: 'entries are tagged with schema_version'.

quorum_core's redefinition: 'admission of a new schema_version is itself a quorum-committed capability config entry into control_lane — leaders restrict writes to the previous schema_version until that config commits'.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition: 'schema-version capability bumps are admitted only after every replica is confirmed at the new code version — a two-phase upgrade: deploy, then activate'; rollout itself is region-staggered like cert rotation under lifecycle_gate.
lifecycle_gate's redefinition: 'region-drain events are a first-class lifecycle event distinct from pool rotation, scheduled and admitted through the same CAS proposal mechanism'.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition: 'quorum-size threshold is computed drain-aware: rotations are not blocked merely because a drain is in flight, but rotations whose admission would drop the post-drain quorum below safe are rejected'.
lifecycle_gate's redefinition: 'at most one region-drain plus one pool-rotation are in flight globally; mutual scheduling is enforced'.
flag_propagator's redefinition: 'documented per-region delivery SLO monitored independently of bulk propagation rate; SLO breach raises an alert'.

flag_propagator's redefinition: 'for high-severity flags (cluster-suspended, key-revocation, erasure-tombstone), publishes a deny-during-propagation pending-marker to every region's auth_cache before the per-region apply lands'.

flag_propagator's redefinition: 'per-region apply produces a flag-applied attestation written back through quorum_core into control_lane; a flag is globally-active only after attestations from every region land; lagging regions surface as alerts'.

offboarding_orchestrator's redefinition: 'each signal carries an idempotency key (offboarding_id, component_id, attempt_id) committed via quorum_core into tombstone_lane so the canonical signal record survives leader change'.
offboarding_orchestrator's redefinition: 'incoming attestations are deduped by idempotency key before aggregating into the certificate of deletion'.

quorum_core definition now distinguishes 'precondition-violation' from 'leader-change' rejection codes and states 'proposers apply exponential backoff with jitter on either, and treat leader-change as transient rather than immediately re-proposing with stale preconditions'.

quorum_core definition now states it 'enforces a per-proposer in-flight CAS budget and a global CAS admission rate so a thrashing proposer cannot saturate consensus throughput; over-budget proposals are rejected fast with a retryable-with-backoff signal'.

quorum_core definition now states 'Snapshot install on a replica is atomic via an intent-then-commit protocol: the replica writes a snapshot-installing intent marker before any state mutation, replaces state files, then writes a snapshot-commit marker; on restart, an intent without matching commit forces full discard of partial snapshot state and re-fetch from quorum'.

quorum_core definition now states 'A replica with an in-progress or failed snapshot install enters a NEEDS_SNAPSHOT state visible to the quorum: it does not vote, does not serve reads (including partition-stale reads), and does not count toward the quorum-size threshold until snapshot install commits and log-tail catch-up completes'.

quorum_core definition now states 'Every lane entry carries an HLC stamp captured at write time; quorum_core validates the stamp at commit time and rejects entries whose stamp is missing or beyond max-allowed-delta from the current HLC, so lane consumers can rely on stamps for cross-lane happens-before reconstruction'.

quorum_core definition now states 'While the leader's hlc_service is in skew-degraded mode, quorum_core suspends admission of entry kinds that participate in security-critical cross-lane happens-before reconstruction (revocation-then-attestation, erasure-tombstone-then-offboarding-attestation, fast-path flag-applied attestations); other admissions carry an HLC-degraded annotation visible to consumers'.

flag_propagator definition now states 'enforces a per-target_identity rate limit on pending-marker publication. Pending-markers beyond the rate are dropped with a metric and the originating proposer is flagged; the per-target_identity rate limit is independent of the unified fast-path's per-region delivery SLO so DoS attempts via pending-markers cannot also starve legitimate flag delivery'.

flag_propagator definition now states 'Pending-markers carry an originating-proposal-id and an HLC expiry bound; flag_propagator rejects any pending-marker publication that is not tied to an in-flight or committed tombstone proposal in tombstone_lane' and 'On HLC expiry the marker auto-clears in auth_cache without explicit retraction, so a stalled or rejected proposal cannot indefinitely deny traffic'.

tip_quorum definition now states 'A probationary (chain, fork_id) candidate that exceeds a documented max-probationary-window without reaching the N-region threshold surfaces an alert listing the observed-region-set and the absent-region-set so operators can correlate against ongoing region-drain or rotation events'.

tip_quorum definition now states '(chain, fork_id) candidate admission requires N independent observations across N distinct regions (not merely N distinct chain_router replicas in the same region); multiple replicas in the same region count once for the threshold so colluding replicas within a region cannot satisfy the threshold alone'.

tip_quorum definition now states 'Source-quarantine rules include set-level cross-source correlation: a (chain, fork_id) candidate witnessed only by sources in suspicious correlation (synchronized timing, identical observation deltas, no other regional witness) is held probationary even when no single source violates per-source rate, and the correlated set is surfaced in alerts'.

lifecycle_gate definition now states 'operator-override probationary-fork admissions (CAS proposals that admit a probationary (chain, fork_id) over the N-region threshold-shortfall, gated on the absent-region-set being explainable by current drain-in-progress or rotation-in-progress entries in control_lane; the override commits to tip_lane with operator attribution)'.

lifecycle_gate definition now states 'Cert rotations on the inter-region channel are admitted only when the remaining validity on the active cert exceeds a documented overlap budget; during the overlap, both old and new cert are trusted on the inter-region channel so consensus on the rotation itself rides the old cert while the new cert is distributed via control_lane, and trust handover to the new cert is atomic at the HLC effective-from stamp recorded with the rotation entry'.

lifecycle_gate definition now states 'If the overlap window is breached (no successful rotation committed before the active cert nears expiry), lifecycle_gate raises an emergency-cert-recovery event in control_lane and stops admitting any non-cert-rotation lifecycle events; recovery from total cert expiry is delegated to a parent-scope out-of-band bootstrap surface — region_coordinator alone cannot recover consensus over a channel whose only authenticator has expired'.

lifecycle_gate definition now states 'documented operational pauses (VM live migration and any successor pause classes — first-class lifecycle events with a recorded pause-window and the affected region(s))' admitted via the same CAS-into-control_lane mechanism as other lifecycle events.

hlc_service definition now states 'hlc_service consults control_lane for pause-in-progress entries scoped to its region; while a pause-in-progress entry covers its region, sample-vs-median delta is evaluated against a wider pause-mode bound and the region does not auto-trip skew-degraded mode for delta excursions explainable by the pause. On pause-end, hlc_service re-syncs from multi-peer median and only then resumes normal max-allowed-delta enforcement'.

quota_aggregator definition now states 'Pre-aggregates incoming deltas in-memory by (tenant, plan_version, tenant_cluster, HLC bucket) before proposing to aggregate_lane, so consensus throughput on aggregate_lane scales with bucket count rather than raw delta arrival rate'.

quota_aggregator definition now states 'When the pre-aggregation buffer exceeds a documented watermark, sheds by ceiling-proximity class: aggregates well under the per-plan ceiling are dropped first with a loss-attestation; aggregates near or crossing a ceiling retain admission priority into aggregate_lane so throttle-flag tombstones are not delayed by low-severity delta floods'.

offboarding_orchestrator definition now states 'Tracks per-downstream-component best-effort-attestation rate; crossing a documented breaker threshold opens a component-outage state for that component: new offboarding signals are suspended, a component-outage alert is raised, and erasure tombstones whose data class would touch that component are held in a queued-pending-component-recovery state in tombstone_lane rather than rapidly accumulating best-effort attestations'.

tombstone_lane definition now states it 'carries queued-pending-component-recovery entries for erasure tombstones whose downstream component is in an open component-outage breaker state (offboarding_orchestrator); the queued-pending entries drain via the normal offboarding flow once the breaker closes, and the queue is itself audited and alerted if its depth exceeds a documented bound'.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition adds the operator-override admission contract: every override CAS proposal must carry M-of-N signatures from distinct registered operator credentials drawn from region_coordinator's published roster, signatures are validated against the current roster version with HLC validity bounds, proposals signed by compromise-revoked credentials are rejected at admission, in-flight override proposals are CAS-invalidated before commit if any signer transitions into the compromise-revoked set, and signing operator identities are persisted into control_lane as a per-operator audit trail. tip_quorum's redefinition makes its operator-override path delegate credential validation to lifecycle_gate (single enforcement point), accepts overrides only when transited through lifecycle_gate's admission contract, and preserves operator-attribution end-to-end. Together they realize the parent-scope operator-credential authorization model (M-of-N, rotation, compromise-revocation, per-operator audit) so a single compromised credential cannot issue override admissions.

residency_publisher redefined: PREPARE binds prepared-V+1 to per-tenant quarantine-and-relocate-complete-ack from tenant_store; COMMIT activates V+1 via M-of-regions quorum-witnessed CAS re-validating prepared-ack and per-region ack-quorum; ABORT idempotent on (tenant_key, V+1, attempt_id); PREPARED-ORPHAN on prepared-window expiry. Activation, prepared-ack, abort, prepared-orphan write typed entries via compliance_audit_owner.

residency_publisher redefined: pre-warm hydration channel rate-limited per-region; consumer ack-readies inline as part of registration; bounded queue depth, queue-overflow returns pre-warm-deferred causing deny-by-default for residency-pinned ops; honors monotonic-per-(consumer, instance_id, version) — fresh instance_id starts fresh ack history, same instance_id cannot regress.

credential_roster definition: rotation-prepare commits prepared-V+1 entry to control_lane and broadcasts to override-admission consumers; rotation-activate is M-of-regions quorum-witnessed; consumers consult active roster_version on every commit; in-flight override proposals at activate-HLC cancel-by-roster-version atomically. Compromise-revocation carries retroactive-as-of-HLC; lifecycle_gate re-signs and re-broadcasts in-flight broadcasts whose emit-HLC >= retroactive-as-of-HLC.

lifecycle_gate redefined: drain-fence broadcasts carry the signing roster_version as part of the broadcast itself; consumers verify against the broadcast's NAMED roster_version; broadcasts remain verifiable for the duration of their HLC-bounded ack window even after a scheduled rotation activates a strictly newer version.

lifecycle_gate redefined: on observing erasure-tombstone in tombstone_lane for tenant T, computes fence_HLC f_T and broadcasts drain-fence-broadcast(T, f_T, signing roster_version); offboarding_orchestrator redefined to track per-(T, named-writer) ack state via durable phase markers.

lifecycle_gate redefined: bulk-offboarding admitted into bounded waves with documented max-tenants-per-wave and inter-wave spacing; per-writer bounded ack queues with explicit back-pressure stall further wave admission; per-tenant HLC-bounded ack windows start from per-tenant ack-broadcast-emit-HLC, not from bulk operator action HLC.

lifecycle_gate redefined: node-teardown not admitted while any in-flight per-tenant drain-fence on that node is unacked; nodes that cannot flush within teardown window write durable drain-ack-handoff entry naming successor instance or persistent buffer; offboarding_orchestrator redefined to record drain-ack-handoff via control_lane and treat ack-by-handoff as ack.

lease_issuer subsystem added: lease tokens issued via M-of-regions quorum-witnessed lease-prepared/lease-activated pattern committed via quorum_core to lease_lane; renewal under same lease_id with extended HLC TTL bound; force-revoke and lease-revoked entries; emergency re-bootstrap rooted in cert_bootstrap's OOB anchor under elevated M-of-N narrowly scoped.

lease_issuer definition: writes HLC-stamped handoff-fence entry to lease_lane, calls tenant_store's handoff-fence acknowledgement endpoint at parent, awaits ack, then commits lease-activated for lease_v_new. Ack audited via compliance_audit_owner.

lifecycle_gate (PHASE A) computes fence_HLC f_T; writers ack at writer-local HLC >= f_T + skew_bound; (PHASE B) lifecycle_gate computes t_destroy = max(observed_ack_hlc, f_T + skew_bound) + write-delivery-grace and CAS-commits audit-key DESTROYED to lease_lane. compliance_audit_owner publishes write-delivery-grace bound and installs late-write-rejection cutoff at compliance_audit on DESTROYED commit; late writes rejected at admission and surfaced to protocol-violation log.

gateway_health_surface subsystem added: per-(region, Subrole) liveness samples with monotonic freshness signal; freshness window bounded by hlc_service skew_bound + inter-region propagation budget; routing-affecting classifications require cross-witness from at least two regions; single-region held probationary (classification_pending); stale-surface fallback documented at edge level.

cert_bootstrap subsystem added: OOB trust anchor is M-of-N hardware-rooted material across distinct custodians; anchor-rotation procedure committed via quorum_core; anchor-availability-test cadence committed via control_lane; emergency cert recovery, roster-bootstrap, anchor rotation, emergency lease re-bootstrap under elevated M-of-N; every operation writes typed entry to compliance_audit via compliance_audit_owner.

credential_roster subsystem added; lifecycle_gate redefined to delegate credential validation to credential_roster's published roster (consulted via control_lane); residency_publisher's CAS proposals carry active roster_version; lease_issuer consults credential_roster on every commit; cold-start / post-full-revocation re-bootstrap rooted in cert_bootstrap.

offboarding_orchestrator redefined: maintains durable per-(offboarding_id, component_id) phase markers in control_lane progressing through RECEIVED, FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS, FLUSH-COMPLETE, ACK-EMITTED, ATTESTATION-WRITTEN, TERMINAL; never retracts emitted drain-ack; observed_ack_hlc for slowest writer consumed by lifecycle_gate PHASE B.

lease_issuer redefined: per-tenant lease-quiescent flag published to control_lane; on erasure-tombstone for T force-revokes any active lease for T as part of drain-fence pipeline AND refuses further handoff-fence requests for T (handoff during erasure invalid by construction); flag flips true only after force-revoke commits and any in-flight handoff completed-or-aborted. lifecycle_gate redefined: PHASE B CAS proposal includes lease-quiescent(T) precondition.

compliance_audit_owner redefined: tenant-key-scoped late-write cutoff for T bounds any writer that ever held an active or prepared lease for T at any HLC up to t_destroy; subsequent writes naming T from any writer rejected at admission and surfaced to protocol-violation log. Cutoff is tenant-key-scoped, not (writer_id, encrypted-at-HLC)-scoped.

lifecycle_gate redefined: maintains per-tenant residency-2PC-in-flight lock in control_lane; PREPARE acquires; COMMIT/ABORT/PREPARED-ORPHAN releases; competing PREPARE for same tenant T CAS-rejected with reason 'residency-2PC-already-in-flight'. PREPARED-ORPHAN per (tenant_key, V+1) — fresh attempt_id cannot escape.

residency_publisher redefined: PREPARE pins active roster_version captured from credential_roster's published state; COMMIT and ABORT carry pinned roster_version. credential_roster redefined: rotation-activate is sequenced by lifecycle_gate (admitted only after in-flight residency 2PCs reach terminal state, OR with explicit residency-2PC-cancel-and-abort directive under elevated-tier-A).

residency_publisher redefined: two-mode pre-warm — STEADY-STATE per-region RPS cap; BURST-MODE on quorum-witnessed region-failover event with per-region burst-budget sized to absorb worst-case correlated-cold-start, HLC-bounded burst window matching failover RTO, bulk-snapshot delivery via region-local cache (residency_publisher-controlled, cert-bearing, monotonic-per-(consumer, instance_id, version)); burst-mode-active and burst-mode-terminate events written to control_lane.

offboarding_orchestrator redefined: drain-ack-handoff records are first-class durable obligations with HLC-bounded flush deadline; named successor writes handoff-accepted referencing record-id; handoff-flushed entry on completion with flushed-write attestation; deadline expiry without handoff-flushed escalates exception register entry to handoff-overdue-investigation-required; resolution-with-loss-attestation requires operator M-of-N.

compliance_audit_owner redefined: tenant-key-scoped late-write cutoff for T installed only after every drain-ack-handoff record for T reaches handoff-flushed terminal state OR is resolved-with-loss-attestation under operator M-of-N. PHASE B audit-key DESTROYED commits before handoff resolution only when every handoff record for T carries no-residual-writes-expected flag.

lifecycle_gate redefined: decommissioning a successor buffer is a first-class lifecycle event requiring all pending-flush handoff records the buffer owns to be either resolved or transferred-to-another-successor (recursive handoff re-applying same SLA contract); buffer cannot be decommissioned while any unresolved handoff is still owned by it.

gateway_health_surface redefined: asymmetric partial-trust policy — SAFETY-DIRECTION transitions applied immediately under partial-trust on single-region observation with 'partial-trust-routing-active' annotation/header; PERMISSIVE-DIRECTION transitions require full cross-witness; cross-witness window expiry for permissive-direction transitions escalates to operator-attention via classification-witness-timeout entry to control_lane that pages on-call.

lifecycle_gate redefined to admit operator-override classification under M-of-N elevated-tier-A from credential_roster's published roster; promotes a single-region classification past cross-witness window with operator attribution recorded into health_lane and audited via compliance_audit_owner.

cert_bootstrap redefined: continuous per-anchor liveness via custodian-published heartbeat-attestation to control_lane on documented sub-test-cadence interval; missing heartbeat marks anchor element anchor-unhealthy and raises alarm; M-of-N counts only anchor-healthy elements; anchor-healthy below M raises anchor-quorum-degraded proactively. anchor-availability-tests retained as defense-in-depth against heartbeat falsification.

cert_bootstrap redefined: anchor rotation admitted by lifecycle_gate as first-class lifecycle event subject to bounded-batching; replacement anchors join under still-reachable elevated M-of-N applied against anchor-healthy count. Emergency recovery thresholds (elevated-tier-A, elevated-tier-B) reference M-of-N against anchor-healthy count, never against total anchor count, so degradation is monotonic.

lifecycle_gate redefined: bulk-offboarding wave admission CAS proposal includes lease_issuer's dedicated lease-revoke sub-budget headroom AND every named-writer's bounded queue depth AND residency-2PC-in-flight lock set as preconditions; admission rejected with explicit reason on precondition failure; backs off with exponential-with-jitter.

lease_issuer redefined: dedicated lease-revoke-during-erasure CAS sub-budget within per-proposer in-flight CAS budget, not consumable by routine lease ops; routine-budget headroom and dedicated-sub-budget headroom published separately to control_lane.

offboarding_orchestrator redefined: drain-acks carry writer's hlc_service status (healthy/skew-degraded/pause-mode) at ack-emission time as typed annotation signed by writer's hlc_service over cert-bearing inter-region channel; offboarding_orchestrator rejects drain-acks emitted under skew-degraded; pause-mode emits drain-ack-pause-deferred records with pause-window HLC bounds.

lifecycle_gate redefined: PHASE B t_destroy uses observed_ack_hlc only when every contributing drain-ack was emitted under healthy hlc_service; otherwise computed from worst-case drain-ack-pause-deferred completion HLC + skew_bound + write-delivery-grace; PHASE B does not commit until any pause-window has ended and healthy-mode drain-ack has landed for affected writers.

lifecycle_gate redefined: re-sign-and-rebroadcast does NOT reset per-tenant ack windows for tenants whose phase markers had already reached an ack-completed phase under original signing; re-emission carries per-tenant signature-only-update annotation that updates the broadcast's signing roster_version in offboarding_orchestrator's phase marker without resetting the window. Only tenants not yet ack-completed receive a fresh ack window.

lifecycle_gate redefined: re-emission has dedicated bandwidth budget within broadcast pipeline, separate from new-wave admission, sized as fraction of total broadcast pipeline capacity to bound impact on new-wave admission.

credential_roster redefined: compromise-revocation broadcast carries explicit per-tenant reaffirmation-or-reissue decision tree based on offboarding_orchestrator's phase marker state — ack-completed -> reaffirmation entry (signature update only); not-yet-ack-completed -> reissue with fresh ack window. compliance_audit_owner records the per-tenant decision in the typed audit log.

residency_publisher redefined: per-(tenant_key, V+1) prepared-window dynamically sized from tenant_store's estimated_quarantine_duration captured in preliminary PREPARE-estimate exchange; window = max(min-window, estimated_duration * documented_safety_margin) capped at absolute-max-window; estimate bounded by per-tenant quotas in control_lane; one-time prepared-window-extended on observable progress (committed and operator-visible). PREPARED-ORPHAN remains safety net for genuine stalls beyond absolute-max-window.

offboarding_orchestrator's redefined certificate-of-deletion structure (s4-1) carries the deletion_status enum (CLEAN | PARTIAL_HANDOFF_LOSS | RESIDENCY_ABORTED | AUDIT_KEY_PHASE_A_PENDING | COMPOUND) with required terminal-fact roll-up over per-component phase markers, residency 2PC outcome, audit-key destruction phase, and handoff-record SLA terminal state per (offboarding_id, tenant_id, component_id).

offboarding_orchestrator MUST refuse to issue a certificate while any handoff-record SLA is non-terminal unless an explicit operator-attested resolved-with-loss-attestation override (signed under elevated-tier-A from credential_roster) is recorded in control_lane and referenced by the certificate — encoded in the redefinition.

compliance_audit_owner's redefined certificate-of-deletion admission contract rejects any certificate lacking required deletion_status / terminal-fact roll-up or referencing an unrecorded resolved-with-loss-attestation; rejection is recorded as audit-rejection entries in control_lane and triggers paging on-call.

lifecycle_gate's broadcast pipeline shed-and-defer encoded: when in-flight residency 2PC PREPAREs exceed a watermark, non-critical PHASE A audit-key destruction entries are deferred via explicit deferral records in control_lane (cause + HLC) and re-emitted automatically when the watermark clears.

lease_lane redefined with two priority sub-streams within reserved consensus throughput: lease-revoke-priority (lease-revoked, lease-revoke-during-erasure, force-revoke) and lease-prepared (M-of-regions ack-collection); revoke-for-T MUST commit ahead of any prepared-for-T regardless of arrival order; cross-tenant entries preserve FIFO within sub-stream.
lease_issuer's redefinition emits prepared-orphan when force-revoke or lease-revoke-during-erasure supersedes an in-flight lease-prepared for the same tenant; backlog bounded under per-tenant cap.

lease_lane redefinition: lease-prepared entries carry an admission-deadline-HLC; expired entries transition to prepared-expired, are reaped from lane head, and emit a prepared-expired audit entry referencing the originating M-of-regions ack window.

lifecycle_gate's bulk-wave admission CAS proposal precondition includes lease_issuer's dedicated lease-revoke sub-budget headroom — i.e., bulk-wave is budgeted strictly against the lease-revoke-priority sub-stream, not total lease_lane capacity. Back-pressure on bulk-wave fires when the revoke sub-stream nears its budget independent of lease-prepared occupancy.

gateway_health_surface stamps every safety-direction partial-trust transition for region R with a lease_lane-cross-witnessed-up-to HLC; the transition is not published until lease_lane has been observed up to that HLC at the publisher (gateway_health_surface now reads_from lease_lane), and the value is recorded in the health_lane entry per redefinition.

health_lane redefinition mandates consumers (e.g., edge) MUST refuse to apply partial-trust headers for region R until they have observed lease_lane up to the lease_lane-cross-witnessed-up-to HLC carried in the transition.

lease_issuer's redefinition stamps lease-revoke and lease-revoke-during-erasure entries with the originating-region-set of the lease so health_lane and consumers can determine which leases are within scope of a region-down partial-trust transition.

quorum_core's redefinition extends the HLC-degraded interlock classification to cover lease_lane {lease-prepared, lease-revoke, lease-revoke-during-erasure, force-revoke, prepared-orphan, prepared-expired, prepared-revoked, lease-reissue} and health_lane {partial-trust-transition, classification-pending, classification-witness-timeout, anchor-quorum-degraded, region-set-failover} as security-critical; under HLC-degraded mode such entries are suspended with explicit deferral records in control_lane.

quorum_core's redefinition: under HLC-degraded mode, lease-revoke and lease-revoke-during-erasure retain priority but MUST be HLC-stamp-revalidated against hlc_service immediately before commit; revalidation failure transitions the entry to revoke-pending-hlc-recovery with a deferral record.

health_lane redefinition: partial-trust-transition entries emitted while quorum_core is HLC-degraded are downgraded to safety-direction-only and carry an hlc-degraded-source flag; consumers treat the cross-witness stamp as provisional and MUST NOT relax safety guards on its basis.

lease_issuer's redefinition introduces prepared-revoked state for lease-prepared entries bound to a compromised roster_version; transition is atomic with the compromise-revocation broadcast; prepared-revoked entries cannot commit even if late M-of-regions acks arrive afterward, and are reaped on a bounded schedule.

lease_lane's redefinition adds the third lease-reissue priority sub-stream with its own bounded budget; entries are HLC-ordered after the compromise-revocation broadcast HLC and MUST NOT commit before any lease-revoke for the same tenant. credential_roster's redefinition directs reissue work into this sub-stream via lease_issuer.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition surfaces an explicit back-pressure signal (recorded in control_lane and paged on-call) when the lease-reissue sub-stream budget saturates beyond a configurable horizon following compromise-revocation; signal carries elapsed reissue lag and count of pending reissues.

gateway_health_surface's redefinition tags every classification-pending and partial-trust-transition entry with originating-cause-class (operator-bulk-wave, regional-network, internal-degradation, unknown) sourced from lifecycle_gate's bulk-wave context (correlated by wave_id observed in control_lane); health_lane redefinition records the tag.

gateway_health_surface's redefinition: entries tagged operator-bulk-wave are subject to a separate, longer classification-witness-timeout SLO; per-entry pages suppressed and replaced by a single bulk-wave-health-summary published once per wave; only deviations from the wave's expected health envelope page on-call.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition publishes bulk-wave-start and bulk-wave-end markers on control_lane carrying (offboarding_id, wave_id, expected-region-set, expected-degradation-envelope); health_lane consumers correlate via wave_id.

lifecycle_gate's redefinition records rotation-activation-HLC in control_lane: records signed strictly before verify under V_old and records signed strictly after verify under V_new. credential_roster's redefinition retains V_old as verifiable for at least max(residency-2PC-in-flight-lock max-window, drain-ack-handoff record SLA max-window) past activation.

residency_publisher's redefinition: roster-pin at PREPARE includes the rotation-activation-HLC observed at PREPARE; if a strictly-newer rotation-activation-HLC lands in control_lane while in PREPARE, the 2PC must complete before the activation HLC or transition to residency-2PC-cancel-and-abort under elevated-tier-A directive issued via lifecycle_gate. COMMIT re-validates that no newer activation HLC has landed.

compliance_audit_owner's redefined cross-version chain-of-custody acceptance contract: V_old-signed records are accepted while rotation-activation-HLC and V_old verification key are within the bounded retention window declared by credential_roster; out-of-window records are flagged audit-key-expired-cannot-verify and routed to manual review.

offboarding_orchestrator's redefinition embeds the roster_version under which a drain-ack-handoff record was signed AND the rotation-activation-HLC observed at signing time, so cross-version verification is unambiguous on replay.

gateway_health_surface's redefinition monitors the dependency graph of in-flight partial-trust transitions (it now reads_from lease_lane to compute cross-witness HLCs) and detects cross-witness deadlocks; on detection it classifies the regions as a region-set-failover and issues a single coordinated transition whose cross-witness HLC is computed against quorum_core's quorum-observed lease_lane HLC.

lease_issuer's redefinition: when gateway_health_surface signals a region-set-failover (read via the new lease_issuer -> health_lane edge), lease_issuer emits lease-revoke entries for tenants whose leases name any region in the region-set under quorum_core's commit witness, breaking cross-region cross-witness deadlock cycles.

health_lane's redefinition adds an explicit region-set-failover entry kind whose payload includes the union region-set, the coordinated cross-witness HLC, and the originating-cause-class; consumers apply a single barrier per region-set-failover rather than per-region barriers.
